description_excerpt: Job Description Exciting new opportunities to develop and maintain a cloud native platform which provides support to develop cloud native application, following a modern design pattern (microservice architecture based on containers). The platform integrates a lot of well-known open sources such as Apache Cassandra, Kafka, Zookeeper, Geode, Elasticsearch, Grafana, Prometheus… You will be working with common microservices used by several applications in a core network solution. By joining the team, you will get the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art cloud native, microservices…
